verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਜਲੁ ਕਾਸਟਹਿ ਨ ਬੋਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨੋ ਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau saritaa jal kaasaTeh na borat karat chit laaj apano iee pratipaario hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the water of streams and rivers does not sink the wood, it (water) has the shame of the fact that it has irrigated and brought the wood up;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਇਆਨਪਨ ਤਊ ਨ ਜਨਨੀ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਉਰਧਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau karat sut anik iaanapan tuoo na jananee avagun uradhaario hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a son commits many mistakes but his mother who has given him birth never recounts them (she still keeps loving him).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਨ ਸੂਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau saran soor pooran pratagiaa raakhai lakh aparaadh ke'ee maar na biddaario hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a culprit who may have myriad vices is not killed by a brave warrior in whose refuge he may have come, the warrior protects him and thus fulfils his virtuous traits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee param gur paaras paras gat sikhan ko kirat karam kachhoo na beechaario hai ||536||

en.bdb: Similarly the supreme benevolent True Guru does not dwell on any of the faults of His Sikhs. He is like touch of philosopher-stone (True Guru removes dross of the Sikhs in His refuge and makes them gold-like precious and pure).   (536)
